description_en: Queries customer orders on the China site (Chinese mainland). This operation can be called only on the Chinese mainland site
description_zh: 国际站客户订单查询，只允许国际站调用
kebab_example: aliyun agency get-customer-orders --order-id 209335720330622 --customer-account test_123 --customer-uid 123456 --order-type RENEW --order-status 3 --time-type 2 --start-date 2024-08-13_00:00:00 --end-date 2024-08-23_00:00:00 --customer-manager myBd --product-type vm_intl --order-source 0 --page-size 10 --page-no 1 --api-version 2022-12-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCustomerOrders

parameters.help_en: The order ID. This parameter is optional
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The order type. Valid values:
BUY: new purchase.
UPGRADE: upgrade.
DOWNGRADE: downgrade.
RENEW: renewal.
REFUND: refund.
OTHERS: other
parameters.help_zh:
订单类型:
BUY: 新购
UPGRADE: 升级
DOWNGRADE: 降级
RENEW: 续费
REFUND: 退款
OTHERS: 其他
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The order status. Valid values:
1: unpaid.
2: canceled.
3: paid
parameters.help_zh:
订单状态：
1 未支付
2 已废弃
3 已支付
parameters.name: order_status

parameters.help_en:
The time type. Valid values:
1: payment time.
2: order placement time
parameters.help_zh:
时间类型：
1 支付时间
2 下单时间
parameters.name: time_type

parameters.help_en: The start time. This parameter is used together with TimeType. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，与timeType结合使用。格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time. This parameter is used together with TimeType. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，与timeType结合使用。格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The order source. Valid values:
0: regular customer.
1: enterprise customer.
2: secondary reseller
parameters.help_zh:
订单来源：
0 普通客户
1 企业客户
2 二级经销商
parameters.name: order_source

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size
